_meta.source: 21st.dev inspired — adapted for Crafter Agency AI client DNA system
_meta.description: Feature sections, bento grids, CTA banners, stats, testimonials, footer, and FAQ. All prompts use {{CLIENT_*}} DNA variables.

templates.name: Features — 3-Column Icon Grid
templates.description: Three-column grid with icon, feature title, and short description. Clean, scannable feature overview.
templates.prompt:
Build a 3-column features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section: background:#07070f, padding:100px 0.
Header: eyebrow 'Why {{CLIENT_NAME}}', H2 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', centered.

Grid: CSS grid 3 cols (desktop), 2 cols (tablet), 1 col (mobile), gap:24px, max-width:1100px, margin:48px auto 0.

6 feature cards (use {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}} + 3 more from brief):
Each card: padding:28px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), border-radius:16px, background:#0c0c1a.
- Icon container: 48px × 48px, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 0.12), border-radius:12px, centered icon (SVG or emoji).
- Feature title: 16px, 700 weight, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, margin-top:16px.
- Description: 14px, line-height:1.6, color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55).

Hover: border-color → {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 40%, transform:translateY(-4px), transition:all 0.3s.

GSAP ScrollTrigger: cards fade-in from y:30 opacity:0, stagger:0.1s.
Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Bento Grid Asymmetric
templates.description: Asymmetric bento tiles of varying sizes. Important features get larger tiles. Apple/Linear-style layout.
templates.prompt:
Build an asymmetric bento grid features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

CSS Grid: columns repeat(4, 1fr), rows auto, gap:16px, max-width:1200px.

Tile sizes and content:
- Tile A (col:span 2, row:span 2): Hero feature card. Background: gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}. Large icon top. Title '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}' (24px bold). Description paragraph. CTA link '→ Learn more'. Overflow hidden with decorative graphic bottom-right.
- Tile B (col:span 2, row:span 1): Second feature. Background:#0e0e1e. Illustration or diagram placeholder. Short title + 1-liner.
- Tile C (col:span 1, row:span 2): Tall narrow card. Icon centered, title, stat number (animate count-up). Background:#0c0c1a.
- Tile D (col:span 1, row:span 1): Small stat card. Big number + label. {{CLIENT_USP_2}}.
- Tile E (col:span 2, row:span 1): Wide card. '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' with before/after visual.
- Tile F (col:span 1, row:span 1): Small. Social proof count or integration logos.

All tiles: border-radius:20px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), overflow:hidden.
Hover: scale(1.02), border-color rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 0.3), transition 0.3s.

Mobile: single column, all tiles full width.
GSAP scroll reveal stagger. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Alternating Rows (Zigzag)
templates.description: Zigzag rows with text on one side and visual on the other, alternating. Detailed feature storytelling.
templates.prompt:
Build an alternating features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section: background:#07070f, padding:80px 0.
Section header: H2 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', centered, mb:64px.

3 alternating rows (each ~80px padding top/bottom, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)):

Row 1 (text-left, visual-right):
- Left 50%: eyebrow label '01', H3 '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', description paragraph (2-3 sentences about this feature), feature bullets list (3 items with checkmarks), optional CTA link.
- Right 50%: visual card with border-radius:16px, border, background #0d0d1e, aspect-ratio:16/9, containing a mock UI screenshot placeholder or gradient with icons.

Row 2 (visual-left, text-right): same structure reversed.

Row 3 (text-left, visual-right): same as row 1. Feature: '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}'.

On scroll: text side slides in from its side (x:±40→0), visual slides from opposite side. GSAP ScrollTrigger, scrub:false, once:true.

Colors: accent {{CLIENT_COLORS}} on eyebrow labels and checkmarks.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Tabbed Interface
templates.description: Tabbed feature showcase. Each tab shows a different feature with a visual panel. Keyboard navigable.
templates.prompt:
Build a tabbed features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Layout: full-width, background:#07070f.
Header: H2 '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

Tab navigation: horizontal pill tabs (desktop) or scrollable tab strip (mobile). 4 tabs: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}', 'Integrations'. Active tab: background:{{CLIENT_COLORS}}, text:white. Inactive: ghost.

Content panel below tabs (min-height:400px): left 40% = text (title, description, 3 bullet points, optional CTA). Right 60% = visual panel (border-radius:16px card with mockup/illustration placeholder, or animated gradient for each tab with different colors).

Tab switch: content fades out opacity:0 translateX(-10px), new content fades in from right. Duration:0.25s.
Keyboard: arrow keys navigate tabs.

Auto-advance option: every 5s, advance to next tab (progress bar under active tab indicator).

{{CLIENT_COLORS}} as accent throughout. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}.
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Scroll-Sticky Visual Reveal
templates.description: Sticky visual on one side, feature descriptions scroll past on the other. Visual updates as user scrolls.
templates.prompt:
Build a sticky scroll features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (21st.dev scroll-narrative style).

Outer container: position:relative, height:300vh.
Inner: display:flex, 2 columns.

Left column (sticky): position:sticky, top:0, height:100vh, width:50%. Contains a card/visual that CHANGES as user scrolls. The visual starts as feature 1 state and morphs to feature 2, then feature 3.
Visual states: 3 panels each with different background gradient from {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, different content/icon, opacity transitions.

Right column (scrolling): 3 feature blocks each ~100vh padded. ScrollTrigger on each block — when it enters viewport, it updates the left sticky visual (add/remove CSS class or change data attribute).

Each right block: large feature number (01, 02, 03) in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, H3 feature title ({{CLIENT_USP_1/2/3}}), description paragraph, 3 bullet points.

Progress indicator: thin vertical line on far left, colored segment grows as user scrolls through sections.

GSAP ScrollTrigger: scrub:1 for visual transitions. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Before/After Comparison Slider
templates.description: Side-by-side comparison showing without vs. with the product. Draggable divider line.
templates.prompt:
Build a before/after comparison section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section: dark background, centered.
Heading: 'See the Difference {{CLIENT_NAME}} Makes', subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

Comparison component: position:relative, overflow:hidden, border-radius:16px, max-width:900px, aspect-ratio:16/9.

BEFORE half: left side, grayscale/muted colors, label 'Before {{CLIENT_NAME}}' in top-left corner (semi-opaque pill).
AFTER half: right side, full color with {{CLIENT_COLORS}} accents, label 'After {{CLIENT_NAME}}' in top-right.

Divider: absolute vertical line at 50% initial position. White line, 2px, with drag handle circle (40px, white background, ↔ icon). Pointer events: drag left/right, updates clip-path on AFTER half.

Drag logic: mousedown on handle → mousemove updates position (min:5%, max:95%), updates before half width and after clip-path accordingly.

Below comparison: 3 stat callouts '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' with large numbers.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Icon Wall (Dense Grid)
templates.description: Dense grid of small icon+label tiles. Perfect for integrations, supported formats, or a large feature set.
templates.prompt:
Build a dense icon wall section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} features or integrations.

Heading: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' centered. Subtext: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

Grid: auto-fill columns minmax(120px, 1fr), gap:8px, max-width:1000px. ~24–32 icon tiles.

Each tile: padding:16px 12px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), border-radius:12px, background:#0c0c1a. Center-aligned: icon (32px, can be emoji or SVG from Lucide CDN), label below in 12px muted text.

Tiles divide into: category header tiles (full-row span, background:#0a0a14, border-color:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}},0.2), text:{{CLIENT_COLORS}} uppercase 10px tracking-widest) + individual feature/integration tiles.

Categories: 'Core', 'Integrations', 'Outputs', 'Enterprise'. Under each: 6-8 tiles.

Hover on tile: border-color:{{CLIENT_COLORS}} 60%, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}},0.06), scale:1.02, show tooltip with 1-liner description.

GSAP: stagger reveal 0.03s per tile. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Dark background. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Features — Accordion Expandable List
templates.description: Vertical accordion of collapsible feature rows. Full description reveals on expand. Smooth animation.
templates.prompt:
Build an accordion features section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}, tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Section: max-width:800px, centered, padding:80px 0.
Heading: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

8 accordion items. Each item:
- Closed state: row with icon (left), feature name (bold 16px), '+' icon (right). Border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06). Padding:20px 0.
- Open state: '+' becomes '−' (rotates 45deg, transition). Below the title row: expanded content div slides down (max-height:0→auto using JS, transition:max-height 0.4s ease + padding-bottom:20px). Content: description paragraph + 2-3 bullet points + optional image/screenshot placeholder.

JavaScript: click toggles open/closed. Only one open at a time (close others).

Features list: {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}} + 5 more derived from {{CLIENT_SECTOR}} context.

Active item title: color:{{CLIENT_COLORS primary}}.
Icon in title: 24px circle background rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS}},0.1).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Background: transparent (sits on dark page). Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Full-Bleed Gradient Banner
templates.description: Full-bleed section with gradient background, centered heading, and primary CTA. Maximum conversion focus.
templates.prompt:
Build a full-bleed CTA section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-width section, min-height:400px, display:flex align-items:center justify-content:center.
Background: linear-gradient(135deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} 0%, {{CLIENT_COLORS second}} 100%). Or use radial-gradient(ellipse at center, {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} 0%, darker shade 70%).

Optional texture overlay: url("data:image/svg+xml,...") grain texture at 5% opacity.

Content: centered, text-align:center.
- Eyebrow badge: 'Get Started' or '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}}' in white semi-opaque pill.
- H2: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — white, 48px, font:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, font-weight:700.
- Subtext: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — white at 80% opacity, 18px.
- CTA group: primary white button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' (background:white, text:{{CLIENT_COLORS primary}}, hover:scale 1.03). Ghost button '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' (border:2px white, text:white).
- Trust line below buttons: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}} · No credit card required · Cancel anytime' in white 70% opacity 13px.

Decorative: faint SVG pattern or CSS dots in background at 8% opacity.
GSAP: content fades in from y:30 on scroll. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Split Card (Text + Button)
templates.description: Contained card with heading on one side and CTA button on the other. Subtle, elegant inline CTA.
templates.prompt:
Build a split CTA card for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

A single horizontal card: max-width:900px, centered, border-radius:20px, background:#0e0e1e, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), padding:40px 48px.
CSS flex: space-between, align-items:center. On mobile: column stacked.

Left side (flex:1):
- H3: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — 26px, 700, {{CLIENT_FONT}}.
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — 14px, muted.

Right side (flex-shrink:0, ml:40px):
- Primary CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' — pill button, background:linear-gradient(135deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS}}), text:white, padding:14px 32px, font-weight:700.
- Below: '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' text link if applicable.

Card left-border accent: 3px solid gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}} on left side (or top on mobile).
Subtle glow: box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, 0.08).
GSAP: card slides in from left on scroll. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Sticky Bottom Bar
templates.description: Fixed bar at viewport bottom with message, CTA, and dismiss option. Appears after 3s or on scroll.
templates.prompt:
Build a sticky bottom CTA bar for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Bar: position:fixed, bottom:0, left:0, right:0, z-index:100, background:rgba(8,8,16,0.95), backdrop-filter:blur(16px), border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), padding:14px 24px.
Initially: translateY(100%) (hidden). After 3 seconds OR after user scrolls 40% of page: animate translateY(0) — 0.5s cubic-bezier.

Inside bar: flex row, justify-content:space-between, align-items:center.
- Left: emoji icon + bold text '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' (truncated on mobile) + muted subtext '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.
- Center: CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, pill shape.
- Right: dismiss X button (sets cookie/localStorage to not show again for 7 days).

Mobile: stacked — text line 1, then CTA full-width, then dismiss link text.

If dismissed: bar slides back down. If CTA clicked: track click (console.log or gtag if available).

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 14px. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Dual-CTA Section
templates.description: Two equal CTAs side by side. Primary and secondary action with clear visual hierarchy.
templates.prompt:
Build a dual-CTA section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} with two distinct paths.

Section: centered, padding:80px 0, background:#07070f.

Heading: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' centered, 40px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 700.
Subtext: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' muted, 18px, max-width:560px centered.

Two CTA cards side by side (flex, gap:24px, max-width:720px, centered, mt:48px):

Card A (Primary Path):
- Background: gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, border-radius:20px, padding:40px.
- Icon + title (larger, bolder): '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}'
- Description: 2 lines explaining path A.
- CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' white button.
- Badge: 'Most Popular'

Card B (Secondary Path):
- Background:#0e0e1e, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), same size.
- Icon + title: '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}'
- Description: path B description.
- CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' ghost button.

Below both cards: small trust line with {{CLIENT_USP_3}}.
GSAP: cards scale in from 0.9→1. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Inline Email Capture
templates.description: Email input and submit button inline beneath heading and subheading. Newsletter signup or trial start.
templates.prompt:
Build an inline email capture CTA section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: centered, padding:80px 0.
Background: subtle radial glow in {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 10% opacity behind content.

Content center stack:
- Small badge pill: '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}} · Join {{CLIENT_USP_1}}'
- H2: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — 44px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 700.
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — 18px muted.
- Email form (mt:32px): flex row — <input type=email placeholder='Enter your email'> + <button> '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}'.
  - Input: flex:1, height:52px, padding:0 20px, border-radius:12px 0 0 12px, background:#0e0e1e, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), color:white, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}.
  - Button: height:52px, padding:0 28px, border-radius:0 12px 12px 0, background:{{CLIENT_COLORS primary}}, color:white, font-weight:700, white-space:nowrap.
  - Mobile: stack vertically, both full width, both border-radius:12px.
- Below form: '{{CLIENT_USP_2}} · {{CLIENT_USP_3}} · No spam, unsubscribe anytime.' 12px muted.
- Success state: form fades out, '✓ You're on the list! We'll be in touch.' fades in.

Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Testimonial + CTA Combo
templates.description: Featured customer quote above the CTA for social proof. Combines trust and action.
templates.prompt:
Build a testimonial + CTA combo section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Layout: centered column, max-width:680px, padding:80px 0.

Top: large quote mark (" in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 80px, font-family:serif, opacity:0.4).
Testimonial quote: italic, 22px, line-height:1.6, white, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}. Approx: 'Using {{CLIENT_NAME}} completely transformed how we approach {{CLIENT_SECTOR}}. {{CLIENT_USP_1}} is exactly what we needed.'
Attribution: flex row — avatar placeholder circle (40px) + name 'Jane Doe, CEO at Acme Corp' in 14px muted.

Divider: 1px horizontal line, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), margin:40px 0.

CTA block below divider:
- H3: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — 32px, 700.
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — 16px muted.
- Button group: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' filled + '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' text link.
- Trust microtext: '{{CLIENT_USP_2}} · {{CLIENT_USP_3}}'

Background: dark, subtle gradient blob behind testimonial.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. GSAP fade-in. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: CTA — Feature Announcement Banner
templates.description: Slim top-of-page banner with 'New' tag, short message, link, and dismiss option. Drives feature awareness.
templates.prompt:
Build a feature announcement top banner for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Bar: position relative (at top of page, above navbar), or position:fixed top:0 z-index:200. Background: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} gradient. Width:100%, padding:10px 20px. Flex: center, gap:12px.

Content: 'NEW' badge (white semi-opaque pill, font-size:10px, font-weight:800, letter-spacing:0.1em). Short message: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}} — now available for {{CLIENT_NAME}}'. Arrow link: '→ {{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' (underline on hover).

Dismiss button: absolute right:16px, × icon, opacity:0.7, hover:opacity:1. On click: bar slides up (translateY(-100%)), store in sessionStorage.

On page load: check sessionStorage — if dismissed, don't show.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 13px, white text. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Stats — Horizontal 4-Column Numbers
templates.description: Four large numbers in a row with descriptive labels underneath. Count-up animation on scroll.
templates.prompt:
Build a stats/metrics row section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: dark background (#07070f), padding:60px 0, border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04), border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04).

4-column grid (2 cols on mobile), max-width:900px, centered:
Each stat:
- Large number: 56px, font-weight:300, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, color:white. Gradient on the number unit: 'k', 'M', '+', '%' in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- Label: 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing:0.2em, color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4), font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, mt:8px.

Stats values (adapt to {{CLIENT_SECTOR}}):
- '10k+' / '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}'
- '99%' / '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}'
- '2M+' / '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}'
- '#1' / 'Trusted Platform'

Count-up animation: IntersectionObserver triggers when section enters viewport. For each stat, animate from 0 to final value using requestAnimationFrame, duration:1.8s, easeOutExpo easing.

Vertical separator lines between stats (display:none on mobile).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Stats — Icon + Stat Pairs with Cards
templates.description: Bordered stat cards each with relevant icon, animated number, and label. Hover reveals more detail.
templates.prompt:
Build a stat cards section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section header: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', centered, 36px.

Grid: 4 cards (2×2 on mobile), gap:16px, max-width:920px, mt:48px.

Each stat card: padding:32px, border-radius:16px, background:#0c0c1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), text-align:center.
- Icon container: 52px × 52px, margin:0 auto 16px, border-radius:14px, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.12). Icon inside: 24px emoji or SVG.
- Number: 48px, font-weight:300, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, color:white. Suffix in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- Label: 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing:0.18em, muted.
- Hover detail: a 'p' tag hidden by default, shows on hover (max-height:0→40px), contains extra context about this stat.

Hover card: border-color:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.4), transform:translateY(-4px), transition:all 0.3s.

Count-up: same IntersectionObserver pattern.
GSAP scroll reveal stagger:0.1s. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Stats — Logo Bar + Stats Combo
templates.description: Customer logos row above or beside key stats. 'Trusted by' header + logo grid + key metrics.
templates.prompt:
Build a trust/social-proof section combining logos and stats for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: padding:80px 0, background:#07070f.

Top sub-section — Logo bar:
'Trusted by teams at:' label centered, 12px muted uppercase.
Logo row: flex, justify-content:center, gap:40px, flex-wrap:wrap, mt:24px, mb:48px.
6-8 company name placeholders styled as: opacity:0.3, filter:grayscale(1), font-weight:700, font-size:18px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Hover: opacity:0.7, filter:none, transition:0.3s.
Infinite marquee option for many logos: CSS @keyframes scroll, animation:20s linear infinite.

Divider: 1px horizontal rgba(255,255,255,0.06).

Bottom sub-section — Stats:
3 large stats centered: '10k+ Users', '99.9% Uptime', '4.9★ Rating'.
Adapt numbers to match {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}.
Each stat: number (52px bold, gradient text {{CLIENT_COLORS}}) + label (12px muted).
Separated by vertical dividers.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Stats — Stats Over Full-Bleed Background
templates.description: Full-bleed gradient or image background with stats overlaid. Maximum visual impact.
templates.prompt:
Build a full-bleed stats section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-width section, min-height:320px, position:relative, overflow:hidden.
Background layer: linear-gradient(135deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} 0%, {{CLIENT_COLORS second}} 100%) plus a subtle noise texture at 8% opacity.
Optional: CSS animated gradient (background-size:200%, @keyframes shifts position 0%→100%→0% over 6s).

Overlay: rgba(0,0,0,0.2) to ensure text readability.

Content (z-index:10, centered, py:80px):
- H2: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — white, 36px, centered, mb:16px.
- Subtext: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — white 70%, mb:48px.
- Stats row: 4 stats, each: number (white, 64px, font-weight:300, {{CLIENT_FONT}}) + label (white 60%, 12px uppercase). Separated by thin white vertical lines (height:50px, width:1px, opacity:0.2) on desktop.

Count-up on IntersectionObserver.
Decorative: subtle grid dots in background (white 8%).

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Stats — Progress / Achievement Bars
templates.description: Animated progress bars showing completion percentages, scores, or skill levels.
templates.prompt:
Build a progress/achievement stats section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: max-width:700px, centered, padding:80px 0.
Heading: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

6 progress bars (stacked vertically, gap:24px):
Each row:
- Top line: label left ({{CLIENT_FONT}}, 14px, white), percentage right ({{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, 14px, font-weight:700).
- Bar track: height:8px, border-radius:100px, background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06), width:100%.
- Bar fill: border-radius:100px, background:linear-gradient(90deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS}}), width:0 initially → animates to target % on scroll.

Bars with values (adapt to {{CLIENT_SECTOR}}):
- '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}': 94%
- '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}': 87%
- '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}': 98%
- 'Client Satisfaction': 96%
- 'On-time Delivery': 92%
- 'Team Expertise': 89%

Animation: IntersectionObserver → each bar fills with CSS transition width duration:1.4s easeOutExpo, stagger 0.15s per bar.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Background: dark. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Testimonials — 3-Column Quote Cards
templates.description: Three side-by-side quote cards with avatar, name, role, and quote. Classic effective layout.
templates.prompt:
Build a 3-column testimonials section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: background:#07070f, padding:100px 0.
Heading: 'What Our Clients Say' or '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', centered. Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

3-column grid, gap:20px, max-width:1080px, mt:48px:

Each card: padding:32px, background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:16px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), display:flex, flex-direction:column.
- Stars row: 5 × ★ in {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at top.
